intro: You are running inside aq-confine. There is no network access and no credentials. Failed network calls are expected; do not retry them in a loop.

profiles.worktree-rw: Only the current worktree is writable. Commit on the current branch with git add and git commit. Pushing is impossible by design; the orchestrator promotes your commits after the run.
profiles.readonly-analysis: Inputs are read-only. Write results only to the scratch directory you were given.
profiles.eval-untrusted: Only the temporary directory is writable.

denials.nonglobal: Not reachable by design; use the model URL and the package mirrors if provided.
denials.nogrant: A request was filed; continue offline and do not retry in a loop.
denials.service-down: Not enabled on this host; report it in the handoff.
denials.cap: Rate limit reached; wait before retrying.
